settings.xvfb_screen: 7680 pixels wide; height grows to tile selected window count

sharing.ztty: same broker socket in shared mode; separate socket per window in independent mode

history.contents: history workload writes 100000 numbered rows; other workloads keep empty history

workload_details.history: 100000 numbered rows (11.9 MB input); configured history capacities have different units
workload_details.images: one 256x256 raw RGBA Kitty image per window; successful OK reply required
workload_details.hidden: all OS windows except one unmapped after initialization; not a tab benchmark

No scrolling or animation in the memory sample.
PTY completion is measured with cursor-position replies (DSR).

method.application_memory: sum smaps_rollup PSS and Private_Clean+Private_Dirty for every marked terminal process and helper, excluding known probe subtrees and isolated infrastructure
method.memory_aggregation: median of three process snapshots per run; median of requested fresh-process repetitions per matrix cell
method.latency_aggregation: per-run p50/p95 across window_count x 300 measured DSR round trips; median of requested repetitions
method.output_aggregation: median of three 1 MiB output bursts per window, then median of selected windows and repetitions
method.performance_scope: one PTY producer at a time; visible windows are focused, hidden windows remain unmapped; write-to-DSR logical processing completion
method.output_integrity: after timed samples, replay the same payload outside timing and require direct CPR at row 32 column 120; ztty also checks all final screen text through its private broker; this is not a physical frame fence
method.cold_warm: fresh terminal processes and isolated config per run; memory sampled after fixed frame and font warm-up; OS page/font caches are not flushed
method.graphics_scope: Xvfb software rendering only; X-server PSS delta and XRes client pixmaps recorded separately; does not quantify native GPU/VRAM or desktop compositor behavior
method.window_visibility: windows tiled on a private X display; hidden workload retains all windows but maps only one
method.desktop_services: private EXTERNAL-authenticated D-Bus without service activation directories; GTK accessibility disabled; portal/accessibility desktop services are outside this isolated configuration
method.ordering: app order rotates each repetition; one app/count/mode/workload cell runs at a time
method.limitations: single machine; history capacities have different units; startup waits for DSR, not first presentation; native GPU VRAM and input-to-display latency unavailable

derived.combined_pss_formula: median across 1 runs within each count/mode/workload/application cell of (run.application.Pss_bytes + run.xserver.after.Pss_bytes); includes full dedicated Xvfb baseline
derived.swap_formula: range/max over every recorded application memory snapshot; for the combined counter add xserver.after.Swap_bytes from the same run before taking range/max
derived.scope: resident PSS excludes swap; Swap counters remain separate and are not added to PSS as a unique physical-memory total
derived.missing_counters: Derived values remain null if any required counter or sampled snapshot is unavailable; missing values are never zero-filled.
